The Phil30 app is designed for everybody up to the age of 30 and helps you get more out of your concert experience at Philharmonie Luxembourg: discover the best upcoming events at the concert hall, from classical music, live cinema, jazz, world music to electro and buy on the go your tickets at the special price of 10 €.

Powered by POST Luxembourg, the Phil30 concert tickets and app enable the next generation to easily explore music through live concerts. Thanks to POST, concertgoers up to the age of 30 (or aged 30 and younger) can easily benefit from a favourable rate of only 10 € per ticket.

Available seats can be easily booked by using the app on the day of the concert from 10 am until 1 hour before the concert or directly at the box office from 1 hour prior to the concert.

•	Discover upcoming events: stay in the know on what’s going on today, this week, this weekend…

•	Explore music through a vast selection of concerts: with our thematic worlds, discover great events you might otherwise have missed
•	Share events with your friends on social media, Emails…

Our tip: Activate the push notifications to always be kept up to date about when tickets go on sale.
